summary.name: DeepCode AI
summary.one_liner: DeepCode AI is the AI engine behind Snyk's application security platform, used to scan, autofix, and prioritize code vulnerabilities.
use_cases: Scanning source code for security vulnerabilities
Getting AI-suggested fixes for security issues
Prioritizing vulnerabilities by package popularity and reachability
summary.what_it_does: DeepCode AI is the AI component that powers the Snyk AI Security Platform, and the page describes it as a code analyzer that finds, autofixes, and prioritizes vulnerabilities and manages tech debt. The page claims 19+ supported languages, 25M+ data flow cases, and multiple AI models. It combines symbolic and generative AI with machine learning and Snyk security researcher input, which the page says avoids hallucinations. Risk scoring uses package popularity, reachability of vulnerable code, and exploit maturity. DeepCode AI Search lets teams write, test, run, and save custom rules using DeepCode AI logic with autocomplete.
notable: Hybrid AI combining symbolic and generative AI with security-specific training data
Autofix suggestions with a stated 85% accuracy
Risk-based prioritization using package popularity, code reachability, and exploit maturity
Custom rule creation with DeepCode AI Search
caveats: Page is mainly marketing; the 85% autofix accuracy and 84% MTTR reduction are vendor claims without independent sourcing
Free sign-up is offered, but the page points to 'Discover our plans' for paid tiers and does not give pricing details
Presented as part of Snyk; the page does not describe it as a standalone product
